title: GAP Waiver Premier 150 Worksheet: Value Floor Percent by Months in Force
content:
For a GAP Waiver Addenda Premier 150 worksheet benefit, the value floor percent follows the whole months from the addendum's enrollment date to the date of loss.

| Whole months from enrollment to the date of loss | Value floor percent |
|---|---|
| fewer than 24 | 80 percent |
| 24 to 35 | 70 percent |
| 36 or more | no floor |

**Boundaries:**

- 23 whole months gives 80 percent;
- 24 whole months gives 70 percent;
- 35 whole months gives 70 percent;
- at 36 whole months there is no floor.

*Hypothetical case.* An addendum enrolled 30 whole months before the loss has a 70 percent floor. On a vehicle value of 13000.00 for the floor, the floor is 9100.00.
